info.title: Kast callable reference
info.description: Public compiler-grounded Kast callables for connected agents.

post.description: Inspect or explicitly control one selected IDEA workspace. Ordinary semantic calls prepare the exact project and wait for native readiness automatically; do not use this tool as a routine read preflight. For a requested control operation, open, present, release or close an exact project. The host owns document save, VFS refresh and model reload selection. Opening is background best effort. Preserve returned host and project identities and reuse request IDs only for the same operation. Pending work requires status, not repeated open. Trust and failed saves require user resolution. Release never closes a project. Borrowed or presented projects are protected from agent cleanup; request_user_close requests exact-target controller approval.

post.description: Run, resume, and read one compositional compiler-grounded Kotlin symbol query. For exact name search, use {"request":{"type":"RUN","source":{"type":"SEARCH_DECLARATIONS","declarationName":"Order"}}}; source is directly inside request. For one-hop references, add "steps":[{"type":"WALK","relation":"REFERENCES","maximumDepth":1}] inside RUN. To keep the result, set request.retention to RETAIN; then page its returned reference with request.type READ_RESULT and request.result. Resume execution with request.type RESUME and its exact continuation. Apply structured predicates, relation expansion, bounded walk, set composition, and retained binding projection and joins. Join preserves both named output cells and occurrence evidence; anti-join requires complete right coverage. Choose symbol, occurrence, traversal record, or binding row output. Retained results preserve qualification and omissions; execution continuation and result presentation cursor remain distinct.

request.description: Exactly one closed query action: run, resume, or read_result.

relativeDirectoryPath.description: Directory relative to the session workspace root, such as services/orders. Use '.' for the root. Not a file path, absolute path, glob, or package name. Parent traversal and non-canonical paths are rejected by server admission.

includeSubdirectories.description: true includes the named directory and nested directories; false selects only the named directory.

items.description: Exact imported Gradle source-set name, such as main, integrationTest, or commonMain.

sourceSetNames.description: Omission or null selects the names main and test. Otherwise use exact imported Gradle source-set names, not paths, globs, or production/test categories. Empty and duplicate lists are rejected by server admission.

packageName.description: Semantic Kotlin package name, such as com.example.orders. Not a filesystem path. Uses Kast's supported package-name grammar.

includeSubpackages.description: true includes the named package and subpackages; false selects only the named package.

items.description: Exact imported Gradle source-set name, such as main, integrationTest, or commonMain.

sourceSetNames.description: Omission or null selects the names main and test. Otherwise use exact imported Gradle source-set names, not paths, globs, or production/test categories. Empty and duplicate lists are rejected by server admission.

declarationName.description: Simple declaration name. Not a signature, source-text query, or qualified name.

nameMatch.description: Omission or null means exact, case-sensitive declaration-name matching. Exact matching returns every matching overload; it does not select one overload. Fuzzy matching requires explicit opt-in.

declarationKinds.description: null includes all four supported declaration families. Supply a non-empty, non-duplicate list to restrict them. The class family means Kast's supported class-like declarations. Constructors are not included.

anyOf.description: Omission or null searches the session workspace recursively in source sets main and test. Otherwise choose one directory scope or one package scope. Source-set restrictions intersect with the chosen scope.

query_symbolsRequest_SearchSource.description: Find declarations and establish exact symbol identities. Source scope restricts discovery only, not later expansion destinations.
query_symbolsRequest_SearchSource.title: SearchSource

declarationKinds.description: null includes all four supported declaration families. Supply a non-empty, non-duplicate list to restrict them. The class family means Kast's supported class-like declarations. Constructors are not included.

anyOf.description: Omission or null searches the session workspace recursively in source sets main and test. Otherwise choose one directory scope or one package scope. Source-set restrictions intersect with the chosen scope.

query_symbolsRequest_AllSource.description: Enumerate declarations under existing bounded execution. All does not mean unlimited work or guaranteed complete coverage.
query_symbolsRequest_AllSource.title: AllSource

items.description: Opaque exact-symbol reference returned by Kast. Copy the token verbatim; do not construct, edit, or substitute a candidate reference.

query_symbolsRequest_Output.description: Omission or null returns symbols with name and location. Choose occurrences, traversal_records, or binding_rows for their typed established evidence.
query_symbolsRequest_Output.title: Output

query_symbolsRequest_ReadResultOutput.description: Present retained symbols or typed binding rows without rerunning stages. Omission or null selects symbol fields and rejects a retained binding-row result.
query_symbolsRequest_ReadResultOutput.title: ReadResultOutput

fields.description: [] requests mandatory identity and kind only. Source adds a committed bounded source window.

query_symbolsRequest_TraversalRecordsOut.description: Present each compiler-confirmed walk record with its hop depth and relation fact.
query_symbolsRequest_TraversalRecordsOut.title: TraversalRecordsOutput

query_symbolsRequest_Predicate.description: A closed predicate over compiler-grounded symbol facts.
query_symbolsRequest_Predicate.title: Predicate

values.description: Keep symbols with one of these compiler-established visibilities. Duplicate values are rejected by server admission.

field.description: Compiler-grounded name, declaration kind, or stable file identity.

value.description: Nonblank literal compared with the selected compiler-grounded field.

query_symbolsRequest_Where.description: Keep symbols satisfying one structured compiler-grounded predicate.
query_symbolsRequest_Where.title: Where

relation.description: One semantic hop. callers means declarations calling the current symbols; callees means declarations called by them. Choose output type occurrences to return individual relation facts, including repeated use sites.

query_symbolsRequest_WalkDepth.description: Maximum semantic hop depth; each walk remains bounded by the hosted traversal ceiling.
query_symbolsRequest_WalkDepth.title: WalkDepth

query_symbolsRequest_WalkStrategy.description: Omission or null uses breadth-first exploration. Bounded fan-out keeps representative deeper paths and qualifies truncated coverage.
query_symbolsRequest_WalkStrategy.title: WalkStrategy

query_symbolsRequest_Walk.description: Traverse each input symbol through compiler-confirmed relations up to the requested depth. Existing traversal execution retains frontier, progress, strategy and partial-expansion evidence.
query_symbolsRequest_Walk.title: Walk

query_symbolsRequest_DistinctSymbols.description: Keep the first row and its evidence for each canonical symbol identity at this position.
query_symbolsRequest_DistinctSymbols.title: DistinctSymbols

query_symbolsRequest_ProjectBinding.description: Select one named symbol cell from each retained or newly joined binding row before symbol stages continue.
query_symbolsRequest_ProjectBinding.title: ProjectBinding

query_symbolsRequest_ExecutionBudget.description: Optional execution allowances. Null or omitted dimensions use configured defaults; positive values are independently clamped to operator and transport ceilings. These controls do not alter query take, scope, or projection.
query_symbolsRequest_ExecutionBudget.title: ExecutionBudget

input.description: Append exact-symbol references or selected rows from one retained result, preserving stream order and multiplicity.

query_symbolsRequest_Concat.description: Concatenate a typed input at this pipeline position. Later steps transform both streams.
query_symbolsRequest_Concat.title: Concat

query_symbolsRequest_Intersect.description: Keep left rows whose canonical semantic identity occurs in the retained right result.
query_symbolsRequest_Intersect.title: Intersect

query_symbolsRequest_Union.description: Form a set union by canonical semantic identity while retaining source qualification.
query_symbolsRequest_Union.title: Union

query_symbolsRequest_Difference.description: Exclude right-hand canonical identities only when retained right coverage establishes absence.
query_symbolsRequest_Difference.title: Difference

query_symbolsRequest_ResultReference.description: Opaque retained-result reference returned by Kast. It is separate from an exact-symbol reference and an execution continuation.
query_symbolsRequest_ResultReference.title: ResultReference

query_symbolsRequest_ResultRowReference.description: Issued identity of one row in one retained result. Supply it with its owning result reference; restoration checks ownership.
query_symbolsRequest_ResultRowReference.title: ResultRowReference

query_symbolsRequest_ResultCursor.description: Optional presentation offset in the immutable retained result. Omission or null starts at zero; this cursor does not resume semantic execution.
query_symbolsRequest_ResultCursor.title: ResultCursor

rowIds.description: Omission or null selects all rows. [] selects no rows. Otherwise select these issued rows, in order, from this result; a subset keeps its source qualification and cannot prove coverage of omitted rows.

query_symbolsRequest_ResultSource.description: Seed a new pipeline from a retained immutable result or selected issued rows. The same semantic basis is checked when Kast restores it, including empty selections and incomplete-coverage qualification.
query_symbolsRequest_ResultSource.title: ResultSource

source.description: Starting declaration search, containing named declaration at file offset, exact-symbol references, or one retained result.

steps.description: Ordered transformations executed left to right. null and [] mean no transformations. A join reads its right side from a retained symbol result. Inner join yields binding rows with named left and right cells; project_binding selects one named cell before symbol stages continue. Semi and anti joins retain symbol rows; anti requires complete right coverage.

retention.description: Omission or null discards the completed result after returning it. retain publishes an immutable bounded same-basis result reference; publication failure is reported without erasing the query result.

query_symbolsRequest_RunAction.description: Run a query from the supplied source and ordered steps. Retain the completed result only when requested.
query_symbolsRequest_RunAction.title: RunAction

query_symbolsRequest_ResumeAction.description: Continue the saved query execution without resending or rediscovering its completed prefix.
query_symbolsRequest_ResumeAction.title: ResumeAction

query_symbolsRequest_ReadResultAction.description: Present an immutable retained result, starting at the supplied result cursor; this performs no query evaluation.
query_symbolsRequest_ReadResultAction.title: ReadResultAction

query_symbolsRequest_ExecutionContinuati.description: Issued execution continuation for an unfinished query pipeline or retained transport output. Copy verbatim. A retained-result reference cannot resume execution.
query_symbolsRequest_ExecutionContinuati.title: ExecutionContinuation

query_symbolsRequest_BindingName.description: One bounded name for a cell in a binding row. Inner joins name their left and right cells; project_binding selects a cell by its name.
query_symbolsRequest_BindingName.title: BindingName

query_symbolsRequest_InnerJoinMode.description: Emit one typed binding row per matching pair. The two output column names must differ.
query_symbolsRequest_InnerJoinMode.title: InnerJoinMode

query_symbolsRequest_SemiJoinMode.description: Keep left symbol rows with a matching right identity, preserving left multiplicity and evidence.
query_symbolsRequest_SemiJoinMode.title: SemiJoinMode

query_symbolsRequest_AntiJoinMode.description: Keep left symbol rows only when complete right coverage proves no matching identity.
query_symbolsRequest_AntiJoinMode.title: AntiJoinMode

right.description: Immutable retained symbol rows. A retained binding-row result is not a symbol right input.

query_symbolsRequest_Join.description: Join on canonical symbol identity. Inner emits typed paired rows; semi keeps proven matches; anti requires complete right coverage to establish absence.
query_symbolsRequest_Join.title: Join

query_symbolsRequest_BindingRowsOutput.description: Present both named symbol or exact-occurrence bindings in each inner-join pair, preserving multiplicity and evidence.
query_symbolsRequest_BindingRowsOutput.title: BindingRowsOutput

file.description: Canonical workspace-relative file path containing the offset.

offset.description: UTF-16 offset inside the named declaration.

query_symbolsRequest_LocationSource.description: Find the nearest named declaration containing this offset, then return its exact compiler-grounded symbol.
query_symbolsRequest_LocationSource.title: LocationSource
